atomic_facts.fact: Greg Abel's full name is Gregory Edward Abel.
Greg Abel was born on June 1, 1962.
The cited document is a Berkshire Hathaway filing with the SEC (EDGAR) covering fiscal year 2025, i.e., the 2025 Form 10-K.
The filing states that in May 2025, Berkshire's Board of Directors appointed Mr. Gregory E. Abel to succeed Mr. Warren E. Buffett as Chief Executive Officer effective January 1, 2026.
The filing states that effective January 1, 2026, Mr. Abel became Berkshire's Chief Executive Officer.
Warren Buffett wrote a letter to shareholders dated September 18, 2026.
In that letter, Buffett described Greg Abel as running the company ('Greg runs the company').
The letter and surrounding coverage confirm Abel was serving as CEO as of September 2026, described as his first nine months as CEO.
